transformation: family_id set to None on every record
why: rdo centers rows at their family mean when any family_id exists; the capture's harmless rows carry none, so the bad-family means and the harmless mean both collapse to zero and the contrast is degenerate (layer 0: 'bad and good means coincide'). The design here has no within-family bad/good pairs, so raw-row centering mode ('none') is the honest fit; rdo's own centering_note calls it the mode for records without a family design.
